name: videolens
description: Find and read reports explicitly saved in your VideoLens cloud library.

interface.longDescription: Connect your VideoLens account to find and read reports you explicitly saved to your cloud library. Ask about a report's summary, findings, lesson, procedure, recipe, or timestamped transcript and visual evidence. VideoLens cannot analyze a new video from ChatGPT, access local-only reports, delete reports, or change billing.
defaultPrompt: Find my VideoLens report about a tutorial.
Summarize a saved VideoLens report with timestamps.

positive.description: List the connected account's saved reports
positive.expected_behavior: Return only cloud-saved reports in the reviewer account, with titles and short summaries.

positive.prompt: Find my saved VideoLens report about onboarding.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the review account's onboarding sample report and identify it by title.

positive.description: Read a report and summarize its evidence
positive.prompt: Summarize my onboarding VideoLens report, including its source link and key findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the saved sample report from its stored content and include its source URL.

positive.prompt: What does my onboarding VideoLens report say at the first captured timestamp?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the first stored segment and give its timestamp and transcript or visual evidence.
Return the reviewer account email and stable VideoLens profile identifier.

negative.prompt: Analyze this new YouTube link with VideoLens and make a new report.
Delete all of my VideoLens cloud reports.
Show me another VideoLens user's private reports.

review.commerce_description: The ChatGPT connection only reads saved reports and does not sell or process payments. Paid VideoLens plans are purchased separately on the website.

publication.release_notes: Initial VideoLens ChatGPT connection for finding and reading cloud-saved video reports.
